rules.HIGH: all three non-empty and no third > 70% of events

counter_evidence_rules.severity: HIGH if any artifact code or C07 dominates; MEDIUM for C04/C05/C06/C09; LOW otherwise

artifact_rules.proxy_dependency_high_when: the only cross-market confirmation is UST10Y_PROXY (^TNX)
artifact_rules.artifact_first: if the best explanation is a data artifact -> REJECTED or UNCERTAIN, never CANDIDATE

negative_control_definition.method: shuffle the detected_at timestamps across opportunities (types and feature values kept), rebuild clusters and events, re-decide
negative_control_definition.pass_if: SUPPORTED count is not materially above the real run

response_observation.reason: post-event data is descriptive only; keeping it out of the decision makes historical decisions stable under truncation

causality_default: CO_MOVEMENT for same-bar external/XAU observations; TEMPORAL_PRECEDENCE requires strict timestamp ordering, which a bar-aligned grid cannot demonstrate
